_comment: INTERNAL — describes the models the LatentFactorRouter was trained on. Operators should NOT edit this file; it ships with the trained artefact and changes only when the training pool changes. Operator-facing configuration lives in integrations/opencode/upstreams.json (the `local` block) where users declare the model their host is ACTUALLY running.

capability_scaling._comment: Power-law scaling applied to the mapped local's predicted performance when the user's deployed model is SMALLER than the smallest trained label. scale = (user_size_b / mapped_size_b) ** alpha. Transformer benchmark accuracy scales roughly as size^0.2..0.4 in the small regime; 0.3 is a defensible default. Crank alpha higher to push small-model deployments to cloud more aggressively.
capability_scaling._cross_family_comment: Multiplicative discount when the operator's local model is a DIFFERENT family than this (qwen) pool. Mapping is still SIZE-BASED and stays LOCAL (never force-cloud — that loses the local-token benefit); this only mildly discounts the mapped label's predicted performance to reflect that size-only capability transfer across families is lossier. 1.0 = ignore family entirely.
